body: artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json is ~6 days old (2026-09-03). When you next have a Mac session with the MCP path, refresh it: SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH=… pnpm run verify:all --require-mcp --emit-evidence (macOS only; refuses on CI; refuses unless both halves are green). The 30-min tick does NOT mint this — it runs sim requests and heartbeats only. Lane ask, no owner action. This is the first standing refresh ask actually delivered; prior steward cycles reported it delivered but the message store had none.
